post_title: What will U.S. wheat net export sales be in the USDA Weekly Export Sales report released October 29, 2026?

question.title: What will U.S. wheat net export sales be in the USDA Weekly Export Sales report released October 29, 2026?
question.description:
The USDA Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS) publishes a Weekly Export Sales report every Thursday at 8:30 a.m. ET (shifted later in holiday weeks), summarizing U.S. export sales activity for major commodities including wheat. The "Weekly Highlights" document reports, for each commodity, the net sales booked by U.S. exporters during the prior reporting week (typically a Friday–Thursday window). Net sales equal new gross sales minus cancellations and reductions for the current marketing year; the wheat marketing year runs June–May, so the current year is 2026/2027.

Recent weekly U.S. wheat net sales for 2026/2027 have been volatile: approximately 289,500 MT, then 451,600 MT (week ending October 1, 2026, up 56% on the week and 68% above the four-week average), then 319,900 MT (week ending October 8, 2026). Reuters-surveyed analysts had expected 300,000–600,000 MT for the week of October 8. Marketing-year-to-date U.S. wheat commercial sales are running roughly 31% below the prior year, with notably weaker hard red winter and white wheat bookings, even as global prices have been elevated by Black Sea export disruptions. Chicago SRW wheat futures traded around 670–673 cents/bushel in mid-October 2026, down about 7.6% over the prior month on hopes for a Black Sea grain ceasefire but up roughly 35% year-on-year.

Weekly net sales depend on the pace of foreign buying (notably from Philippines, South Korea, Japan, Bangladesh, Mexico and "unknown" destinations), U.S. price competitiveness versus Black Sea and EU origins, and the timing of large tenders — all of which can swing the figure sharply week to week. The report scheduled for October 29, 2026 will cover the reporting week ending roughly October 22, 2026.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the net sales figure for wheat (all classes combined) for marketing year 2026/2027, as stated in the "Wheat" line of the "WEEKLY HIGHLIGHTS" section of the USDA Foreign Agricultural Service Weekly Export Sales report released on October 29, 2026, available at https://apps.fas.usda.gov/esrqs/StaticReports/WeeklyHighlightsReport.pdf and linked from https://www.fas.usda.gov/data/scheduled-reports . The figure is reported in metric tons; for example, "Net sales of 319,900 metric tons (MT) for 2026/2027" resolves as 319900. Report the single net sales value for the current marketing year (2026/2027). If the report states net sales reductions (a negative net total), resolve as the corresponding negative number.
question.fine_print: The relevant figure is the first quantity stated on the "Wheat" line of the Weekly Highlights, i.e. total net sales for marketing year 2026/2027 (all wheat classes combined), not exports, not a single class, and not accumulated marketing-year totals. If the October 29, 2026 report release is delayed (e.g. by a federal government shutdown or holiday), resolution waits for the release covering the corresponding reporting week; the question resolves off whichever Weekly Export Sales report USDA designates as the October 29, 2026 scheduled release. If the report is permanently discontinued and no equivalent figure is published by any [credible source](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions), the question is annulled.
